title: Report the workspace protocol state on every onboard result
action: Per decision a4c2c38d (D1). Contract: every `bee onboard` result for a repo root (dry-run --json, --apply, and every return that already carries `notices` and `design_offer`) gains a top-level key `workspace_protocol` = {"state": "missing"|"unreadable"|"invalid"|"valid", "unedited": bool, "issues": [string], "action_needed": bool}. state and issues come from the existing `protocol_state(repo_root)` in verbs/protocol.rs. unedited is true only when the file exists and its bytes equal `render_protocol(&gather_facts(repo_root))` exactly. action_needed = state != valid OR unedited. When action_needed, the notices array gains exactly one entry: `workspace protocol: WORKSPACE_PROTOCOL.md is <what> — finish it now with the Workspace protocol procedure in bee-hive references/onboarding.md`, where <what> is `missing`, `unreadable`, `invalid (<issues joined with "; ">)` or `still bee's unedited render`. When not needed, no notice. Onboard never creates, writes or changes WORKSPACE_PROTOCOL.md. Put the helper (e.g. `workspace_protocol_notice(repo_root) -> (Value, Option<String>)`) in onboard/notices.rs, wire it where build_notices and the design_offer insert already run in onboard/mod.rs; widen visibility in protocol.rs only if needed. Red first: add tests in onboard/tests.rs that drive onboard on temp repos for four cases — no file (missing, notice), a valid hand-edited file (valid, unedited false, no notice), a file written by init_protocol unchanged (valid, unedited true, notice says unedited render), an invalid file (invalid, notice names the issue) — and assert that onboard left the file bytes untouched. Assert observable payload, not internals. No code comments.

truths: onboard payload carries workspace_protocol with state, unedited, issues, action_needed
one notice appears when the file is missing, invalid, unreadable or the unedited render
no notice for a valid edited file
key_links: the notice text points at the Workspace protocol section of bee-hive references/onboarding.md
prohibitions: Never create or change WORKSPACE_PROTOCOL.md from onboard
